description: This Python source file implements a command-line interface (CLI) shell for configuration management, including command parsing, auto-completion, script execution, and interaction with ConfigNode objects. It defines the ConfigShell class with methods for running commands, scripts, and interactive sessions, and handles user input, command parsing, and completion logic.

classes.name: ConfigShell
classes.description: A command-line interface shell for configuration management, supporting command parsing, auto-completion, script execution, and interaction with ConfigNode objects.

methods.name: _display_completions
methods.description: Displays possible command or path completions in columns, invoked by readline.

methods.name: _complete_token_command
methods.description: Completes command tokens or the beginning of a path.

methods.name: _complete_token_pparam
methods.description: Completes positional parameter tokens or keyword parameter keys.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Main completion method called by readline to provide possible completions based on current input.

methods.name: _dispatch_completion
methods.description: Dispatches completion requests to specific token completion methods based on token type.

methods.name: _get_prompt
methods.description: Generates the command prompt string based on current node.

methods.name: _cli_loop
methods.description: Runs the interactive command loop, handling user input and command execution.

methods.name: _parse_cmdline
methods.description: Parses a command line string into components: path, command, positional and keyword parameters.

methods.name: _execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command on a target ConfigNode, handling special results like exit or node change.

methods.name: run_cmdline
methods.description: Runs a command line string, parsing and executing it.

methods.name: run_script
methods.description: Runs a script file containing multiple commands.

methods.name: run_stdin
methods.description: Runs commands read from a file descriptor, starting from root node.

methods.name: attach_root_node
methods.description: Sets the root ConfigNode for the shell.
